caveats: All 4018 baseline days (1992-01-01 to 2002-12-31) were read; per the +/5-day pool windows the climatology/threshold additionally read 1991-12-27 to 1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01 to 2003-01-05. The climatology was computed as specified but is not used in the mask. 299 of 3600 region cells are land (SST NaN on every day) and are 0 in the mask; the 3301 sea cells have finite SST on every target day. Source SST is stored float32 (0.01 K steps); all statistics in float64. Hot-day test: stored kelvin SST >= smoothed threshold. Per-cell joining follows the spec sentence order: runs of >=5 consecutive hot days are MHWs first, then MHWs separated by 1-2 non-hot days are joined, gap days included. The regional active days, and hence the reported event, are identical under the alternative join order (join all hot runs first, keep those >=5 days).
